'''March 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 3 March 2001. [[Michael Mendoza]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1845">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01d1845/ pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pleasanton-north-california-3-3-01d1845/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Mendoza]]
